notes.text: Protein-calorie malnutrition (E40-E46) and cachexia (R64) don't map to any V28 HCC. Still document them for severity and quality.
Only moderate or severe MDD, single or recurrent, maps. Unspecified depression (F32.A, F32.9), mild episodes, and MDD in remission don't.
Acute MI codes apply for 4 weeks from onset. Old MI (I25.2) doesn't map.
Acute stroke codes (I63.-) are for the acute episode. After that, use sequelae codes (I69.-) for residual deficits; history without residual (Z86.73) doesn't map.
Prediabetes (R73.03) doesn't map.
Essential hypertension (I10) doesn't map. Hypertensive heart disease with heart failure (I11.0, I13.0, I13.2) maps to HCC 226; hypertensive CKD maps through the CKD stage code (N18.-).
Stage 3 unspecified (N18.30) maps to HCC 329; 3a and 3b are separate codes. CKD stages 1-2 and unspecified CKD (N18.9) don't map. Dialysis status (Z99.2) doesn't map in V28.
Alcohol abuse (mild AUD, F10.1-) doesn't map. Alcohol dependence (moderate or severe AUD, F10.2-) maps, including in remission.
Cannabis abuse (mild, F12.1-) doesn't map. Cannabis dependence (F12.2-) maps.
Atherosclerosis of the extremities with claudication alone (I70.21-) doesn't map; rest pain, ulceration, and gangrene do. In a patient with diabetes, E11.51 maps to HCC 37.
Only severe persistent asthma (J45.5-) maps. Mild and moderate persistent asthma don't.
Polyneuropathy NOS (G62.9) doesn't map. Diabetic polyneuropathy (E11.42) maps to HCC 37.
Class 1 and 2 obesity don't map. A BMI code (Z68.41-Z68.45) maps only with a provider-documented associated weight diagnosis; the BMI value itself can come from nursing or dietitian notes.
Thrombocytopenia NOS (D69.6) doesn't map.
Iron deficiency anemia and anemia in CKD or chronic disease don't map.
Code active cancer only with current treatment or evidence of disease. Personal history (Z85.-) doesn't map. Adjuvant hormonal therapy (e.g., tamoxifen, letrozole) counts as current treatment.
Long-term anticoagulation after a resolved clot is history (Z86.71-) plus Z79.01, which don't map. Chronic DVT or PE still present maps.
AFib maps even when currently in sinus rhythm if it's still being managed (anticoagulation, rate or rhythm control).
Chronic HCV (B18.2) maps. After a sustained virologic response it's history, not active disease.
Both epilepsy (G40.-) and seizures NOS (R56.9) map to HCC 201.
Device status codes (Z95.-) don't map. Document the underlying rhythm or cardiomyopathy diagnosis.
Leg and foot amputation status maps (HCC 409); toe amputation status (Z89.41-, Z89.42-) doesn't.
Osteoporosis without current fracture (M81.-) doesn't map.
Dialysis status (Z99.2) doesn't map in V28; document the CKD stage or ESRD (N18.5, N18.6).

tips.36: All three diabetes HCCs (36, 37, 38) carry the same weight in V28, and only one counts. Still code the complication, since many carry their own HCC (CKD stage, ulcers, retinopathy).
tips.37: ICD-10 presumes a link between diabetes and conditions listed under "with" (CKD, neuropathy, PAD, retinopathy) unless you document they're unrelated. Code each complication plus any manifestation code it needs.
tips.38: All three diabetes HCCs carry the same weight in V28, and only one counts. Long-term insulin or oral hypoglycemic use goes in Z79.4 or Z79.84.
tips.48: Document the weight diagnosis yourself (morbid or class 3 obesity). BMI codes need an associated weight diagnosis by the provider.
